summary: This article is the first installment of the BestBlogs subscription source curation and sharing series, focusing on WeChat Official Accounts. The author has compiled 375 actively updated WeChat Official Account RSS feeds, categorized according to BestBlogs' nine major classification system (Artificial Intelligence, Investment & Finance, Business & Technology, Software Programming, Lifestyle & Culture, Media & News, Personal Growth, Product Design, Sports). Each source includes its name, priority, description, and recommendation rationale. The article explains why WeChat Official Accounts were prioritized (they host a wealth of high-quality Chinese original content but are difficult to manage) and the value of RSS (transforming platform content into subscribable, portable, open sources). It also provides a download link for the OPML file and hints at future sharing of lists for X/Twitter, podcasts, and other sources. Overall, this is a high-quality information source curation checklist rather than an in-depth analytical piece.
title: BestBlogs Subscription Source Sharing: First Wave – WeChat Official Accounts
